svg.aria-label: Four illustrated student group-role cards around a central rotate symbol made of four curved arrows that pass the role from card to card. Chair, a student with curly hair holding a microphone and raising an open hand: invites everyone to speak, saying “What do you think, …?” Timekeeper, a student with a red bob and glasses holding a stopwatch: watches the clock, saying “Two minutes left.” Language monitor, a student in a green headscarf with a clipboard of ticks and a pencil: ticks phrases people use, saying “You used 4 phrases!” Reporter, a student in a purple jacket with a megaphone: tells the class the result, saying “Our group found that …” Title: Group roles — change roles every activity.
svg.title: Group roles — change roles every activity
svg.text: Group roles — change roles every activity
